title: Prefix address under index dropping
statement: Let $w,b,b'$ and $\mathrm{tail}$ be finite bit strings, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j<2|w|+2$. The bit at index $j$ of the result of dropping the index from the encoding of the encoding of $w,b$ paired with $b'$ equals the bit at index $4j$ of the encoding of that nested string paired with $\mathrm{tail}$. Out-of-range lookups are interpreted as the default bit $0$.
